a_only: =(angle Am B C,angle An B C)
b_only: ¬(angle A B C = Real.pi / 2 ∨ angle B C A = Real.pi / 2 ∨ angle C A B = Real.pi / 2)

∃ (Am Bm Cm An Bn Cn : Point), 
    (AffineIndependent ℝ ![Am, Bm, Cm]) ∧ 
    (AffineIndependent ℝ ![An, Bn, Cn]) ∧ 
    (angle Am Bm Cm = angle An Bn Cn)

goal.b_normalized:
= triangle_seq n
    inner ℝ (An -ᵥ H) (Bn -ᵥ Cn) = 0 ∧ inner ℝ (Bn -ᵥ H) (Cn -ᵥ An) = 0 ∧ inner ℝ (Cn -ᵥ H) (An -ᵥ Bn) = 0 ∧ triangle_seq (n+1) =
      ((ℝ ∙ (Cn -ᵥ Bn)).reflection (H -ᵥ An) +ᵥ An,
       (ℝ ∙ (Cn -ᵥ An)).reflection (H -ᵥ Bn) +ᵥ Bn,
       (ℝ ∙ (Bn -ᵥ An)).reflection (H -ᵥ Cn) +ᵥ Cn ))
  (m n : ℕ)
  (h_distinct : m ≠ n)
  (h_angle_eq : let (Am, Bm, Cm) := triangle_seq m
                let (An, Bn, Cn) := triangle_seq n
                InnerProductGeometry.angle (Bm -ᵥ Am) (Cm -ᵥ Am) =
                InnerProductGeometry.angle (Bn -ᵥ An) (Cn -ᵥ An)) :
  InnerProductGeometry.angle (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A) = π / 3
b_alternatives:
= triangle_seq n
    inner ℝ (An -ᵥ H) (Bn -ᵥ Cn) = 0 ∧ inner ℝ (Bn -ᵥ H) (Cn -ᵥ An) = 0 ∧ inner ℝ (Cn -ᵥ H) (An -ᵥ Bn) = 0 ∧ triangle_seq (n+1) =
      ((ℝ ∙ (Cn -ᵥ Bn)).reflection (H -ᵥ An) +ᵥ An,
       (ℝ ∙ (Cn -ᵥ An)).reflection (H -ᵥ Bn) +ᵥ Bn,
       (ℝ ∙ (Bn -ᵥ An)).reflection (H -ᵥ Cn) +ᵥ Cn ))
  (m n : ℕ)
  (h_distinct : m ≠ n)
  (h_angle_eq : let (Am, Bm, Cm) := triangle_seq m
                let (An, Bn, Cn) := triangle_seq n
                InnerProductGeometry.angle (Bm -ᵥ Am) (Cm -ᵥ Am) =
                InnerProductGeometry.angle (Bn -ᵥ An) (Cn -ᵥ An)) :
  InnerProductGeometry.angle (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A) = π / 3
